capture: read both complete pinned Git blobs; the baseline and stable contracts are byte-identical

knownViolationBaseline.native: KNOWN_ARCHITECTURE_VIOLATIONS is an explicit empty slice and both unexpected and retired entries fail

ruleProjection.no-circular: independent DFS over live production Cargo edges
ruleProjection.extension-api-is-import-free: native protocol crate may import only provider-neutral workdeck-core values
ruleProjection.lib-is-a-leaf: core, markup, migration, and store have empty internal dependency ceilings
ruleProjection.extensions-host-stays-below-surfaces: host may reach core, diff, extension API, and review, never TUI, session, or CLI
ruleProjection.bundled-ui-extensions-render-only: native extension implementation sources may not reference workdeck_cli, workdeck_session, or workdeck_tui
ruleProjection.session-stays-below-app-and-ui: session may reach core, diff, review, and VCS, never extension host, TUI, or CLI
ruleProjection.app-composes-without-ui: adapted to the declared Rust composition root: only workdeck-cli owns the complete product graph and no lower crate may depend on it
ruleProjection.no-dead-modules: static Rust module-tree reachability from every product lib/bin root with separate cfg(test) tracking
ruleProjection.core-leaves-stay-below-bootstrap: core has no upper Workdeck dependency; acquisition and launch composition remain outside it
ruleProjection.review-reducer-is-module-internal: semantic reducer function and re-export are pub(crate), with a source gate preventing public exposure
ruleProjection.changeset-internals-stay-in-module: workdeck-diff implementation modules are private and only deliberate facade items are re-exported
ruleProjection.packages-stay-standalone: each crate dependency is constrained by the ownership ceiling and only the CLI is the production composition root
